task.title: Fix bulk send to use Gmail/Outlook web compose instead of mailto
task.description: In bulkSendAll(), replace the mailto link construction with openEmailCompose(). Current broken code builds: let mailto='mailto:'+toEmail+'?subject=...'. Replace with: const emails=gEmails(); const fromEmail=(sel&&sel.value!==''&&emails[parseInt(sel.value)])?emails[parseInt(sel.value)].addr:''; openEmailCompose(toAddr,subject,body,fromEmail); Also change the stagger interval from 800ms to 1000ms. Remove the window.confirm() after bulk send — replace with a toast: toast(opened+' email drafts opened','success'); Do not show a confirm dialog at all. These are the only changes needed in bulkSendAll().

blocking_issues: AI Guide chat modal lacks keyboard accessibility - no focus trap, no Escape key to close, cannot tab to close button
Guide input field and send button have no ARIA labels or accessible names for screen readers
Chat messages div (#guideMsgs) not marked as live region - screen readers won't announce new AI responses
Guide toggle button is a div with onclick - not keyboard accessible (cannot tab to it or activate with Enter/Space)
Mobile navigation: sidebar (230px fixed width) will break layout on mobile devices - no responsive breakpoints or hamburger menu implemented
Modal overflow issues: modals have max-height:92vh but no guaranteed scrollability for long content on small screens
Touch targets: buttons/nav items don't meet minimum 44x44px touch target size (some as small as 4px padding) - accessibility violation
No keyboard navigation: modals lack focus trap, no visible focus indicators beyond CSS outline, no ESC key handling apparent
Form validation feedback: no aria-invalid, aria-describedby connections between inputs and error messages - screen reader users won't hear errors
AI Guide modal is not keyboard accessible - no focus trap, cannot tab to close button or send button, and Escape key won't close modal
Guide button and modal lack ARIA labels/roles - screen readers won't understand the chat interface structure
Guide input field has no associated label - fails WCAG accessibility requirements
